scope: One-off nominal CAD evidence for the fixed fluid pack, TPU receiver and retention geometry. Original native-review hashes and their scopes remain bound to the receiver/support results. Current construction and fixed-pack evidence are bound separately to pack-integration-review.json; external-route-review.json records the current source-authored routing check against the posed native obstacle snapshot. Regenerated whole-appliance closure is a separate result. No insertion force, pressure sealing, retained grip, food-contact or lifetime qualification is established.

fixed_pack.scope: Native fixed-pack result at the source binding retained above. The current fore-valve row and fore-link geometry are recorded under current_fixed_pack.

receiver.capture_screen_scope: The two translated positions establish geometric collar engagement against the clamped keeper. They do not establish permitted receiver travel, compression, extraction force or load capacity.

fixed_support.scope: Native fixed support, removable rear bar and original2.85mm keeper review at its retained source bindings. Current3mm keeper/current metal and continuous-motion coverage is separately recorded under current_keeper. This record does not qualify loads or printed fits.
fixed_support.arm_revision_coverage: Per side the 3 mm arm moves from absolute local X11.25..14.25 to X12.25..15.25. Every added X14.25..15.25 strip is checked separately against the full pack; the removed inner strip cannot introduce an occupied-volume clash. The two support-post end extensions and all six current washer/head envelopes are separately checked. Remaining base stock is unchanged between the recorded source hashes.
fixed_support.tee_ties: Eight owned 6-inch 18 lb narrow ties, two per tee, through the fixed collar saddle windows. The 3.0 mm outer and end ligaments are nominal stock, not a qualified tie load path.
fixed_support.local_wall_scope: The local wall contains the broad rear recess, 7 mm wet section, matched receiver collars, lock pilots and the front Ø22.5 guard counterbores through Y82.5. Full enclosure assembly is reviewed separately.

factory_lock_hardware.washer: Owned uxcell DIN125A M3 flat washer, OD7/ID3.2 x0.5 mm, B0F9KKJ22M; one per lock

fixed_support.metadata_only_update_after_native_review: Three keeper axial-station/clearance fields are added only inside pump_receiver.engineering_record. Removing exactly those lines reconstructs the native review's receiver source hash. All other reviewed source files retain their recorded hashes; TPU printable geometry and all checked assembly geometry are identical.

documentation_source_binding.scope: Source comments and the posed_manifold docstring describe the stationary tee/receiver geometry and preserved fitted pump datum. No geometry or native review is rerun. Original native-review hashes and result scope remain unchanged.
documentation_source_binding.identity_method: Python AST equality with source locations omitted and leading docstring expressions removed from modules, classes and functions. Comments are excluded by parsing. This checks executable AST identity; intentional documentation and __doc__ text changes are outside that identity.

source_binding_scope: source_sha256 retains the source bindings of the original receiver/fixed-pack review. The original fixed-support native bindings and documentation-only AST identity records remain unchanged; current_fixed_pack and external_routes identify the subsequent scoped geometric results.

current_fixed_pack.scope: Fresh local fixed manifold at fore rise10; no regenerated whole appliance or physical qualification is implied.

external_routes.scope: Seven actual source routes installed together against the full named native obstacle snapshot with the current fore-row and WAGO translations. Printed support/shell regeneration remains outside that local result.
